title: What the Sun Bear mirrors

is_this_you.pressure: Your temper lights fast and burns out by evening. The Ox in you still remembers where the line was.
is_this_you.love: You fall for whoever plays gently, and you copy their smile before you know their name.
is_this_you.cost: Your face says yes before your mouth checks the plan. Then you keep that promise for years.

opener.text: In 2019 researchers watched 22 sun bears at a conservation centre in Borneo and found they copied each other's faces exactly [s11]. Before that, exact facial mimicry was known only in humans and gorillas [s11]. The surprise was that the sun bear is not a social animal [s11]. You were born an Aries in an Ox year. You work best alone, and your face still answers a friend's before you have decided anything.

howto: Three parts. Read whichever one smiles at you first.

tabs.label: The mirror face
tabs.intro: Fire on top. Earth underneath, warming slowly.

rows.text: Aries is cardinal Fire, ruled by Mars, direct and quick to start [s1] [s2]. The Ox is yin Earth, patient, and gets where it is going by steady effort [s3] [s4]. Your Fire keeps the Ox's field warm. You start things hot and finish them slowly, which few people manage in one body.

In the Borneo study the copying showed up mostly in gentle play [s11]. A loner that reads faces that well has been paying attention the whole time. So have you. You catch a shift in someone's face across the clearing, and yours answers before you have chosen what to say.
The Ox is a poor talker and would rather be alone than in a crowd [s3]. So your face does the talking for you. Sometimes it agrees to things your words would have questioned.

tabs.label: Sitting high
tabs.intro: Up in the branches, where the sun comes through.

rows.text: The sun bear is the most at home in trees of all the bears, and it sleeps and sunbathes in them, often two to seven metres up [s9] [s12]. Left in peace, it also rests on the ground or in a hollow log [s6]. You take height when you need to think. You come back down for the few who have earned the ground floor.
Solo specialist work suits you: restoration, audit, field conservation. Aries nerve starts it and Ox patience finishes it. Let one person watch the work now and then.

tabs.label: Who you mirror
tabs.intro: Three faces worth copying. One you keep pulling against.
tabs.love_lead: In love you show care by handing over what you found, and only much later do you let a partner watch the search. You need someone whose smile you are glad to copy. Three matches stand out in the old system.

easy.why: The Sand Cat (Sagittarius, Snake year) shares your trine of Ox, Snake and Rooster, and Sagittarius is Fire like you [s5] [s1].
The Sunset Moth (Leo, Rooster year) closes the Ox's trine, and Leo makes the third Fire sign [s5] [s1].
The Sandgrouse (Sagittarius, Rat year) is your secret friend, since the Rat is the Ox's six-harmony partner, and Sagittarius shares your Fire [s5] [s1].

hard.why: The hard one is the Luna Moth (Libra, Goat year): the Goat clashes with the Ox, and Libra sits opposite Aries [s5] [s1].

story.k: He who likes to sit high
story.text: San Diego Zoo records a local name for the sun bear, basindo nan tenggil, which means he who likes to sit high [s6]. The smallest bear in the forest, and its name gives it the top seat [s9].

closing: Sit as high as you like. When a friendly face looks up at you, let yours answer it.
